div.div: 4 ابره He adduced the evidence or proof: (Msb, K:) but as to ↓ بَرْهَنَ , meaning he manifested the evidence or proof, it is said, on the authority of IAar, to be post-classical; the former being the correct word: (AA, T, Z, Msb, TA:) or the former signifies he adduced, or uttered, or did, wonderful things, and overcame men. (K.) Q. Q., or, as some say, Q., 1. بَرْهَنَ: see 4; and see art. برهن.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
